visualCharacteristics: Model (+ transmission) dropdowns, collapsible spec groups with zebra 2-column fact grid, measurement images with dimension lines, variant-specific footnotes
contentPattern: Rows: [fuel type | model | transmission] starts a variant (first = default, URL hash with model slug preselects); [h3 heading] group; [image | dimension] measurement; [label | value] fact; last single-cell row: footnote paragraphs starting with <sup>n</sup>. Option: short (3 columns).
